data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #3 - implicit_assumption): Scope dd-3 grep targets to DISPATCH BLOCK INSTRUCTIONS only — NOT producer output. The dispatch INSTRUCTS the producer to declare DELTA OUTPUT and quote evidence, but actual producer-output assertions are sibling story a7c0's responsibility. Update AC scoping: grep for 'DELTA OUTPUT' as an instruction directive in the dispatch block, NOT as an assertion of agent runtime output.
